title: The Melody That Led Travelers Astray
central_conflict: visitors following musical trail markers repeatedly reached the wrong clearing
decisive_choice: two different chimes produced identical notes when heard across the valley
resolution: retuned one marker and added visible route symbols
story_beats: At the library courtyard, fox and rabbit discovered visitors following musical trail markers repeatedly reached the wrong clearing before the final ferry, leaving the stranded travelers waiting.
Fox attempted an immediate fix, but they repainted the arrows but the detour persisted; rabbit stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Rabbit examined the evidence and realized two different chimes produced identical notes when heard across the valley; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the stranded travelers watching, they retuned one marker and added visible route symbols, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

title: The Aqueduct's Hidden Tremor
central_conflict: the aqueduct walkway shook only when the town fountain stopped
decisive_choice: a pressure surge struck a loose valve whenever the fountain shut off
resolution: installed a controlled valve closure and verified the walkway remained stable
